name: Mermaid: SSH Tunnel for MySQL - sequenceDiagram
code:
sequenceDiagram autonumber participant App as "MySQL Client
@Client PC" participant ClientSSH as "SSH Client
@Client PC" participant SSHServer as "SSH Server" participant TargetServer as "MySQL" rect rgb(230, 240, 255) note over ClientSSH, SSHServer: Prerequisite: `ssh -L 3307:target-db:3306 user@server` has been executed ClientSSH ->> SSHServer: Establish SSH tunnel (port 22) end App ->> ClientSSH: ① DB connection request Note right of App: Source: localhost:(random port A)
Destination: localhost:3307 activate ClientSSH ClientSSH -->> SSHServer: ② Transfer data through tunnel Note over ClientSSH, SSHServer: Transfer within encrypted SSH session (port 22) activate SSHServer SSHServer ->> TargetServer: ③ Transfer data via new connection Note right of SSHServer: Source: SSH server:(random port B)
Destination: target:3306 deactivate ClientSSH activate TargetServer TargetServer -->> SSHServer: ④ Response from DB Note right of SSHServer: Source: target:3306
Destination: SSH server:(random port B) deactivate TargetServer SSHServer -->> ClientSSH: ⑤ Transfer response through tunnel Note over ClientSSH, SSHServer: Transfer within encrypted SSH session (port 22) activate ClientSSH deactivate SSHServer ClientSSH -->> App: ⑥ Return response to application Note right of App: Source: localhost:3307
Destination: localhost:(random port A) deactivate ClientSSH

name: Mermaid: Git Flow
code:
gitGraph
    %% --- Initial Setup ---
    commit id: "Initial Commit"
    branch develop
    
    %% --- Feature Development (Feature Branch) ---
    checkout develop
    commit id: "dev-A"
    branch feature/add-login
    checkout feature/add-login
    commit id: "feat-1"
    commit id: "feat-2"
    checkout develop
    merge feature/add-login id: "merge-feature"
    commit id: "dev-B"
    
    %% --- Release Preparation (Release Branch) ---
    branch release/v1.0
    checkout release/v1.0
    commit id: "Release Prep"
    
    %% --- Merge to Main Branch and Tagging ---
    checkout main
    merge release/v1.0
    %% Commented out for environments where 'tag' is not supported
    %% tag "v1.0.0"
    
    %% --- Merge to Develop Branch ---
    checkout develop
    merge release/v1.0
    
    %% --- Emergency Fix (Hotfix Branch) ---
    checkout main
    branch hotfix/v1.0.1
    checkout hotfix/v1.0.1
    commit id: "Critical Bug Fix"
    
    %% --- Merge Hotfix to Main and Develop ---
    checkout main
    merge hotfix/v1.0.1
    %% Commented out for environments where 'tag' is not supported
    %% tag "v1.0.1"
    checkout develop
    merge hotfix/v1.0.1
